summary: Preserve the official Zillow Research CSV loader, normalized SQLite layer, explainable market workflows, safe optional Bridge boundary, and cross-platform HOME behavior on every reprint.
reason: Zillow's public research surface is wide CSV rather than JSON, and the useful product is regional time-series intelligence rather than endpoint wrapping. The CLI must remain scraper-free, attribution-rich, offline-capable, and explicit about financial assumptions.
validated_outcome: Full Go test suite, go vet, CLI/MCP builds, live Austin analytics smoke, SQLite sync/SQL round-trip, local watch diff, and Printing Press full live dogfood (215/215 tests, zero failures) passed.
